analogy.rationale: CYP17A1/CYP11B1 inhibition blocks androgen synthesis, but prostate lines (PC3, VCAP) and most other lines have low/no androgen receptor dependence, so transcriptional impact is limited; androgen receptor antagonists and other androgen-pathway modulators act on the same axis and should give the most similar (still modest) responses.
